reference_sql:
WITH sold AS (SELECT ol.product_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY ol.product_id),
checked AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_checks FROM competitor_prices WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10' GROUP BY product_id)
SELECT COALESCE(s.product_id, c.product_id) AS product_id, COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS units, COALESCE(c.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM sold s
FULL OUTER JOIN checked c ON c.product_id = s.product_id

solver.query:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT l.product_id, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY l.product_id
), checks AS (
  SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_checks
  FROM competitor_prices
  WHERE observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.product_id, c.product_id) AS product_id,
       COALESCE(s.units, 0) AS units,
       COALESCE(c.n_checks, 0) AS n_checks
FROM sold s
FULL OUTER JOIN checks c ON c.product_id = s.product_id
